problem: 618 filings first served by Finnhub on 2026-10-08/09 and one each on 10-07, 10-10 and 10-11 (619 in all) carry no balance sheet; the other 34,327 stored filings are missing it in 0.414% of cases. Total assets is the denominator of cashOperatingProfitability and accrualsToAssets.
whyUndetermined: The collector stored report.bs only; the raw response, its keys, and every re-served copy of a stored filing were not kept.
rules: No stored shard is rewritten, deleted or re-sorted; every correction is a NEW append-only row.
A missing total assets is never imputed, zeroed, taken from another period, another company or a later filing.
A supplemental row is visible from max(availableFrom, acceptedDate, the day the vendor served it); it is never back-dated to the filing day.

The frozen feature path (pipeline/us_cash_profitability.py) reads finnhub-*.jsonl.gz only and is not changed by this plan. Using a supplement in a prospective signal needs a new, hash-frozen feature contract version (protocol step P5).

The P4 historical exploratory run reads signal dates up to 2026-06-05 and filings visible before them; none of the 619 affected filings is visible before that date except the six listed in the P4 preflight, so P4 is unaffected.

steps.what: Run scripts/probe_finnhub_balance_sheet.py once with the owner's own FINNHUB_API_KEY against the committed store snapshot.
steps.command: FINNHUB_API_KEY=... python scripts/probe_finnhub_balance_sheet.py --store <dir of finnhub-*.jsonl.gz from signal-history ledger/fundamentals/us> --output probe.json --raw-out probe-raw.jsonl.gz
steps.writesInto: nothing in the repository or the store
steps.yields: one of SERVED_NOW_COMPLETION_AVAILABLE, BALANCE_SHEET_FOUND_UNDER_ANOTHER_KEY, VENDOR_OMITS_BALANCE_SHEET_FOR_NEWLY_SERVED_FILINGS_ONLY, VENDOR_OMITS_BALANCE_SHEET_ENDPOINT_WIDE, INCONCLUSIVE, plus the raw response bodies the collector never kept
steps.alternativeWithoutAKey: after this change merges, the next nightly collection writes ledger/fundamentals/us/response-health.json, whose seenAgain counters answer the same question for free; its first run compares 829 tickers x two windows of re-served filings against the stored copies

steps.what: Read the S0 verdict and take exactly the matching branch.

branches.BALANCE_SHEET_FOUND_UNDER_ANOTHER_KEY: S2_SUPPLEMENT after a parser change that reads the new key; the change and its tests are a separate reviewed PR
branches.VENDOR_OMITS_BALANCE_SHEET_FOR_NEWLY_SER: BLOCKED_SOURCE: Finnhub does not currently supply the required values for the new quarter; S3
branches.VENDOR_OMITS_BALANCE_SHEET_ENDPOINT_WIDE: BLOCKED_SOURCE: the endpoint stopped supplying balance sheets altogether; S3
branches.INCONCLUSIVE: repeat S0 with a different ticker sample; do not proceed to S2

steps.what: One bounded re-fetch of the affected tickers into a NEW append-only family ledger/fundamentals/us-supplement-v1/finnhub-supplement-YYYY.jsonl.gz.
steps.scope: tickers that have a stored filing without a balance sheet (601 tickers with an October filing, plus the 134 September records with an income or cash-flow statement), one quarterly request from 2026-01-01 per ticker, plus one annual request for the 45 October 10-K filings' tickers
steps.row: the full raw statements as served, supplementOf = the stored filing id, observedAt = the response time, bodySha256 of the response; a row is written only for a filing whose served balance sheet states Assets in a currency unit
steps.requires: S1 branch SERVED_NOW or KEY_MOVED, a reviewed PR for the supplement writer, and the owner dispatching it; nothing here is run by the nightly collection

steps.what: Report BLOCKED_SOURCE for the affected filings and keep the prospective cash-profitability signal unmeasurable until a source states total assets for them.
ownerActions: ask Finnhub support whether financials-reported intentionally omits the balance sheet (bs) for filings first served after 2026-10-07, and whether it will be back-filled
evaluate a second vendor for the balance sheet only, under the vendor-refusal and PIT invariants; SEC hosts remain blocked from this CI egress
if no source is found, defer prospective registration (P5) rather than registering a signal that is dark for the whole cross-section

unaffectedByThisPlan: the US daily price collector and its storage
